summary: Frontend-only test using the simulated electronAPI harness. Mocks: getDrives, listDirectory (built from the scan list), scanForVideos and openFileDialog, plus a mocked TMDB. A new harness /app/tests/test_iter37_import_type.py drives the real Browse Local Drives and Add Files UI. Results: (1) Browse picker PASS. scan-type-picker appears once a folder is selected. scan-folder-btn stays disabled until a pill is picked, and the type is saved in obsidian_cinema_dir_categories and shown in Manage Directories (dir-type select). The picker resets after a scan; it does NOT reset after Cancel/Escape (LOW). (2) Modern Marvels PASS. X:\Docs\Modern Marvels holds 600 loose files with years. Scanned as docs, tv or anim, both directly and through the parent X:\Docs, it always gives ONE merge group 'Modern Marvels | 600 files · whole show'. Merging gives 1 card with 600 parts, with 0 TMDB movie searches (only a TV lookup). (3) Movies\2019 A (2019), B (2019) scanned as Movies: separate cards, no group, PASS. Loose Show.A/Show.B/Show.C SxxExx files in T:\TV scanned as TV: not merged into a folder card (only the Show.A two-part group), PASS. DocFilms Film A/B/C, each with its own year, scanned as docs: separate, PASS. (4) Add Files PASS for the dialog flow. files-type-dialog, the 4 files-type pills, files-type-continue disabled until a pick, and files-type-cancel all work (cancel opens no file dialog and the picker resets on reopen). The naming tip goes to the type dialog. The parent folder is saved with the type. 3 Breaking Bad S01E0x files picked as TV give one merge suggestion named 'Breaking Bad'. Movies type: 2 movies auto-matched individually. (5) Stats page type-stat counts are correct for Add Files (TV 1 title / 3 files; Docs 1 / 3). The category dropdown FAILS for Add Files folders (see issues). (6) Regressions all match the iteration_35 baseline: iter36 run_extras_later_variants on and off (10/10 PASS), run_type_switch, run_type_switch_movies_dir, run_structures; iter35 run_fresh_auto_on/off, run_existing_individual, run_extras_later; iter34 run_suggest, run_scan, run_edges. No page errors anywhere. NEW BUGS: (A) HIGH: a loose single-show folder using standard SxxExx names is never treated as one folder show (details below). (B) MEDIUM: Add Files folders are missing from the category dropdowns.

ui_bugs.issue: Reproduced: X:\TV\Modern Marvels\ holds 'Modern Marvels S01E01..S01E05.mkv', 'Modern Marvels S02E01 - Bridges.mkv' and 'Modern Marvels - Hoover Dam.mkv', scanned as TV or Docs. Expected: one 'show|x:\tv\modern marvels' group with 7 files. Actual: only the 6 SxxExx files are merged, through the numbered-parts fallback group (key 'x:\tv\modern marvels|modernmarvels', show:false). 'Modern Marvels - Hoover Dam' stays a separate card and is auto-matched as a MOVIE (search/movie, tmdb 7617). For Docs, the merged card gets no TV series lookup because g.show is false, so refreshSeriesInfo is skipped. The Add Files Breaking Bad case gives the same non-show group. Root cause: names = normKey(parseFilename(c.file_name).title), but parseFilename does not strip SxxExx. So 'breakingbads01e01' and 'breakingbads01e02' count as different show names, names.size > 1, and the whole folder group bails. Fix: use the partInfo base, e.g. normKey((partInfo(c.file_name) || {}).base || parseFilename(c.file_name).title). The Show.A/Show.B case still stays apart with that change (bases 'showa' and 'showb').

ui_bugs.component: DirectoryDropdowns category menus vs Add Files folders
ui_bugs.issue: Folders typed through Add Files are saved in dir_categories but not in `directories`. CategoryDropdown receives dirs={directories.filter(...)} and counts=libraryCounts.dirCounts, which also uses only `directories`. Result: (a) if no scanned folder has that type, the menu shows 'No folders set as TV Shows yet' with no 'All TV Shows' item, so these files cannot be filtered by type (seen for TV and Docs); (b) if one exists, 'All TV Shows' does show the Add Files card (activeCategoryDirs uses the union), but the badge and 'All' count leave it out ('TV Shows 1' while 2 cards show; Movies: badge 1, 3 cards). TypeStats on the Stats page is correct because it uses the union. Fix: pass the union of directories and dir_categories keys (or the per-category count of cards) into DirectoryDropdowns.

ui_bugs.component: rootShow loose = folder for non-SxxExx films
ui_bugs.issue: An Animations folder X:\Kids holding loose separate films (Toy Story.mkv, Cars.mkv, Shrek (2001).mkv, Up.mkv) is suggested as ONE show card 'Kids | 4 files · whole show'. This happens because the all-distinct-years guard needs every file to have a year. The user can decline with 'Not multi-part', but the files were also skipped by movie auto-match (queueAutoMatch skips files with a showDir), so declining likely leaves them unmatched. Consider requiring the loose files to share a common name base, or skipping folders where most file titles differ.

ui_bugs.component: Free tier limit vs folder shows
ui_bugs.issue: On the free tier (500), scanning the 600-file Modern Marvels folder imports only 499 files (the limit counts files before merging), though they end up as one card. The user's 600-episode example loses 101 episodes on the free tier. This is a product decision; flagged so it is deliberate.

importType resets only after a successful scan. After Cancel/Escape and reopening, the previous pill (TV) is still selected and Scan is enabled. Navigating into another folder also keeps the earlier pick. Reset importType when the dialog closes (onOpenChange false) and possibly when currentPath changes.

The button still reads 'Scan for Movies' and the description says 'Select a folder to scan for movies' even when TV, Documentaries or Animations is picked. The merged Modern Marvels card shows year 1993, taken from the first episode's year.

issues: Picker pills are readable and colour-coded like the category chips; the layout is fine. No contrast problems.

action_items: HIGH: in multiPart.js findPartGroups, base the loose distinct-show name check on partInfo(file).base instead of parseFilename(file).title, so a loose show folder with SxxExx names (plus odd non-numbered files) becomes one 'show|' group, is looked up as TV, and no file is matched as a movie. Re-run run_loose_sxxexx('tv') and ('docs') and run_movies_and_loose (the Show.A/Show.B case must stay apart).
MEDIUM: DirectoryDropdowns: include Add Files folders (dir_categories keys) in each category's dirs and counts, so 'All <type>' exists and badges match the filter.
MEDIUM: reconsider grouping loose files in a typed folder when they clearly differ (Toy Story / Cars / Up); at least make sure declined suggestions still get movie auto-match.
LOW: reset the scan type picker on dialog close; make the Scan button/description text type-aware; consider free-tier counting for folder shows.
critical_code_review_comments: applyImportType calls setShowRoots synchronously before queueAutoMatch/setMovies. That ordering is correct and is why the 600 files skip movie auto-match; keep it if this is refactored.
pickIndividualFiles keeps its own title/year regex parse while handleMoviesFound uses withParsedName; this logic is duplicated.

Add Files folders become dir_categories entries that are not visible or editable in Manage Directories (only `directories` are listed), so a wrong type picked at Add Files cannot be changed later in the UI.

In the activeCategoryDirs filter, a card matches if ANY typed ancestor has the category, while TypeStats uses the deepest folder. With nested typed folders (D:\Media movies + D:\Media\Docs\X docs) a file can show under 'All Movies' but be counted as Docs.

success_rate.frontend: ~85%: all requested flows work and all regressions pass; 1 HIGH grouping bug (SxxExx loose show folders) and 1 MEDIUM filter bug (Add Files folders missing from category dropdowns)

seed_data_creation: None. Isolated browser contexts with sessionStorage/localStorage mocks only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Usage: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter37_import_type.py').read(), g). Then await g['run_browse_modern_marvels'](segs=('Docs',)|('Docs','Modern Marvels'), typ='docs'|'tv'|'anim', auto='on'|'off'), run_cancel_resets(), run_movies_and_loose(), run_add_files(skip_tip, typ), run_add_files_existing_tv_dir(), run_add_files_movies(), run_loose_sxxexx('tv'|'docs') (currently FAIL), run_loose_films_no_years(). open4() forces Pro (patches setItem of obsidian_cinema_is_pro) to avoid the 500 free-tier cap, and overrides getDrives/listDirectory/openFileDialog. The Browse dialog keeps its last path between opens, so browse_to(p, None, []) reopens at that path. The Add Files naming tip button is confirm-naming-tip-files-btn; the Browse tip button is confirm-naming-tip-btn. The older harnesses (iter34/35/36) use Update Library and need no pill click.
